objective: Fix user-reported invisible/delayed caption typing on Android, tighten excessive empty space in Public and scoped Community Wall posts, and retain existing short-text big-letter behavior and approved Wall design.
productionBaselineEvidence: User posted Android Production Wall screenshots on 2026-11-07 confirming approved Wall feed structure, but reported tall blank spaces and delayed/invisible text input. Prior confirmed main e2441104e1640490a937735c15e002bdae518dce includes Home contribution move; installed exact Android OTA runtime 1.3.2 update ID and this new patch publication are not yet independently verified. Source-only DEV release candidate.
chosenApproach: Replace transparent TextInput and overlaid mirror in shared mention composer with immediately visible native TextInput; preserve @mention selection, candidates, account-scoped posting and text-only big letters. Shrink only existing feed-shell gap/margins, duplicated Public header margins, body margins and scoped photo separation; preserve approved Wall structure and media engines.
selectionRationale: Transparent glyphs with asynchronous mirror paint can make typed captions appear delayed or invisible on Android. The same shared component is used by Public and scoped Walls. Header/body margin layering and shared card gap account for screenshot whitespace; adjust only those constants rather than redesign cards.
alternativeApproaches: Only lighten or recolor the mirror overlay (rejected: native text remains transparent and still depends on mirror frame timing).
Replace the composer, post card and media engines (rejected: unnecessary risk to published Wall design and editing behaviors).
Enlarge every photo caption (rejected: approved large-text policy is for short text-only posts, media captions remain one-line).
preserveBehaviors: Approved Wall header, Marites, location tabs, composer entry, Like/Comment/Share and bottom navigation stay unchanged
Public and Organization/Suborganization/Cluster Wall share same caption/memory and card shell
Existing big-text 25sp for 1–80 Unicode codepoints in text-only posts, one-line media caption See more/See less and mention links remain unchanged
Typed mentions and audience-scoped RPC suggestions remain functional; visible native typing supersedes temporary edit-time colored mention overlay only
Media dimensions, signed URLs, upload paths, fullscreen, photo collage, feed paging, scroll callbacks, permission checks, privacy and ad placements untouched
Previously merged Community Contribution Home-only placement remains unchanged
No backend, database, native module, package identity or Expo runtime changes; Android production OTA requires independent release gates
acceptanceChecks: Typed characters are rendered by native TextInput without waiting for overlay
Public, scoped and Reels composer continue to support selected mentions, cursor and tag suggestions
Original caption large-letter policy remains, media captions still one line with expansion
Visible blank spaces shrink between avatar metadata, caption, image and next post with no button target change
Existing Wall composition, scroll anchors, Marites, photo/video and card privacy preserved
TypeScript + regression CI must pass exact branch head before merging
